title: Adding crates/auth to workspace members fixes silent build exclusion
description: crates/auth was absent from the workspace Cargo.toml members array, so cargo build --workspace and cargo test --workspace silently skipped it. Auth tests were never run in isolation and any compilation error in stoa_auth would only surface when a dependent crate was built. The fix — adding crates/auth to members — is the correct approach. The alternative of leaving auth out of the workspace and relying on dependent-crate compilation to exercise it is worse: auth tests are invisible to workspace tooling and the crate cannot be addressed by name in cargo commands. Workspace membership is right for any crate sharing the same release cadence.
